senses.gloss: दुःख् €10 U. (दुःखयति-ते) To pain, afflict, distress.

दुःख a. [दुष्टानि खानि यस्मिन्, दुष्टं खनति खन्-ड्, दुःख्-अच् वा Tv.]
—1 Painful, disagreeable, unpleasant; सिंहानां निनदा दुःखाः श्रोतुं
 दुःखमतो वनम् Rām.
—2 Difficult, uneasy.

दुःख + .{@-खम्@}
—1 Sorrow, grief, unhappiness, distress, pain, agony; सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय
 शोभते Mk. 1. 10; यदेवोपनतं दुःस्वात्सुखं तद्रसवत्तरम् V. 3. 21;
 so दुःखसुख, समदुःखसुख &c.
—2 Trouble, difficulty; Ś. Til. 12; अर्थानामर्जने दुःखमर्जितानां च
 रक्षणे । आये दुःखं व्यये दुःखं धिगर्थाः कष्टसंश्रयाः ॥ Pt. 1. 163.
 (दुःखम् and दुःखेन are used as adverbs in the sense of ‘hardly’
 ‘with difficulty’ ‘or trouble’ Ś. 7. 13; अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
 Bg. 12. 5; Ku. 4. 13; Pt. 1; R. 19. 49; H. 1. 158).
.━{@Comp.@}: दुःखातीत, दुःखान्तः, दुःखार्त, दुःखान्वित, दुःखकर, दुःखगतम्, दुःखग्रामः, दुःखच्छिन्न, दुःखच्छेद्य, दुःखजात, दुःखजीविन्, दुःखत्रयाभिघातः, दुःखदुःखम्, दुःखदुःखिन्, दुःखदोह्या, दुःखप्राय, दुःखबहुल, दुःखभागिन्, दुःखभाज्, दुःखयोगः, दुःखलव्य, दुःखलोकः, दुःखशील, दुःखसंचार, दुःखसागरः
दुःख + -अतीत a. freed from pain.
दुःख + -अन्तः final emancipation.
दुःख + -आर्त, -अन्वित a. pained, afflicted, distressed.
दुःख + -आर्त, -अन्वित a. pained, afflicted, distressed.
दुःख + -कर a. painful, troublesome.
दुःख + -गतम् adversity, calamity; Mb. 12.
दुःख + -ग्रामः ‘the scene of suffering’, worldly existence.

दुःख + -छिन्न a.
—1 tough, hard.
—2 pained, distressed.

दुःख + -च्छेद्य also दुःखोच्छेद्य a.
—1 hard.
—2 to be conquered with difficulty. प्रजानुरागाद्धर्माच्च दुःखोच्छेद्यो
 हि धार्मिकः H. 4. 24.
दुःख + -जात a. feeling pain.
दुःख + -जीविन् a. living in pain or distress; Ms. 11. 9.

दुःख + -त्रयाभिघातः unbearable association of the three sufferings;
 दुःखत्रयाभिघाताज्जिज्ञासा Sāṅ. K. 1.

दुःख + -दुःखम् (instr.) with great difficulty; (धारयन्ती) शय्योत्सङ्गे
 निहितमसकृद्दुःखदुःखेन गात्रम् Me. 95.

दुःख + -दुःखिन् a. having sorrow upon sorrow; मया रक्षति दुःखदुखी
 Bhāg. 11. 11. 19.
दुःख + -दोह्या (a cow) difficult to be milked.
दुःख + -प्राय, -बहुल a. full of trouble or grief.
दुःख + -प्राय, -बहुल a. full of trouble or grief.

दुःख + -भागिन्, -भाज् a. unhappy. Ms. 4. 157. {@भोगः@} occurrence
 of trouble or misery.

दुःख + -भागिन्, -भाज् a. unhappy. Ms. 4. 157. {@भोगः@} occurrence
 of trouble or misery.
दुःख + -योगः infliction of pain; Ms.
दुःख + -लव्य a. hard to be pierced or cut; B. R. 4. 11.
दुःख + -लोकः worldly life, the world as a scene of constant suffering.

दुःख + -शील a.
—1 hard to please
[]
 or manage, bad tempered, irritable; उपेत्य सा दोहददुःखशीलताम् R. 3. 6; Ś. 4.
—2 accustomed to the misery of; कामेकपत्नीव्रतदुःखशीलाम् Ku. 3. 7;
 who is accustomed to (suffer) the misery (hard lot) of a perfectly chaste life.

दुःख + -संचार a.
—1 passing (time) unhappily.
—2 impassable
दुःख + -सागरः ‘the sea of troubles’; worldly life.
दुःखता uneasiness, pain, discomfort; Ch. Up. 7. 26. 2.

दुःखाकृत [दुःखात् प्रातिलोम्ये इति डाच् P. V. 4. 64] Hurt, oppressed;
 N. 22. 138; Śi. 2. 11.
दुःखायते Den. Ā. To feel pain, be distressed. (Also दुःख्यति Den. P.)

दुःखित a. [दुःख तार˚ इतच्]
—1 Distressed, afflicted, pained; दुःखिता यत्र दृश्येरन् विकृताः पापकारिणः Ms. 9. 288.
—2 Poor, unhappy, miserable.
दुःखित + .{@-तम्@} Trouble, distress.

दुःखिन् a.
—1 Distressed, afflicted, pained.
—2 Difficult, painful.
—3 poor, miserable.

दुःखीयति Den. P. To suffer pain, be distressed; दुःखीयति सुखहेतोः
 को मूढः सेवकादन्यः H. 2. 27.
दुस् + -शंस a. Ved. evil-minded, malevolent, wicked.
दुस् + -शक, -शक्त a. powerless, weak.
दुस् + -शक, -शक्त a. powerless, weak.
दुस् + -शकुनम् a bad omen.
दुस् + -शला N. of the only daughter of धृतराष्ट्र given in marriage to Jayadratha.
दुस् + -शासन a. difficult to be managed or governed, intractable.

दुस् + -शासन + .({@-नः@}) N. of one of the 100 sons of धृतराष्ट्र. [He was brave
 and warlike, but wicked and intractable. When Yudhiṣṭhira staked and
 lost even Draupadī, Duhśāsana dragged her into the assembly by her
 hair and began to strip her of every clothing; but Kṛṣṇa, ever ready
 to help the distressed, covered her from shame and
[]
 ignominy. Bhīma was so much exasperated at this dastardly act of Duhśāsana
 that he vowed in the assembly that he would not rest till he had drunk
 the villainʼs blood. On the 16th day of the great war Bhīma encountered
 Duhśāsana in a single combat, killed him with ease, and drank, according
 to his resolution, his blood to his heartʼs content.]
दुस् + -शील (दुश्शील) a. ill-mannered or ill behaved, reprobate.
दुस् + -शृङ्गी a disloyal wife.

दुस् + -ष्ठु see दुस्थ a. unsettled, in calamity; कथं दुष्ठुः
 स्वयं धर्मे प्रजास्त्वं पालयिष्यसि Bk. 6. 132.
दुस् + -संचार a. difficult to be passed; दुःसंचारासु नगरवीथीषु; Pt. 1. 173.

दुस् + -षम (दुःषम or दुष्षम), {@-सम@} (दुःसम or दुस्सम) a.
—1 uneven, unlike, unequal.
—2 adverse, unfortunate.
—3 evil, improper, bad.
दुस् + -षमम्, -समम् ind. ill, wickedly.
दुस् + -षमम्, -समम् ind. ill, wickedly.
दुस् + -सत्त्वम् an evil being.

दुस् + -सथः
—1 a dog.
—2 a cock; L. D. B.

दुस् + -संधान, -संधेय a. difficult to be united or reconciled.
 -मृद्घटवत् सुखभेद्यो दुःसन्धानश्च दुर्जनो भवति Subhāṣ.

दुस् + -संधान, -संधेय a. difficult to be united or reconciled.
 -मृद्घटवत् सुखभेद्यो दुःसन्धानश्च दुर्जनो भवति Subhāṣ.
दुस् + -संस्थित a. very sinful or ugly to look at; Rām. 2. 9. 40.

दुस् + -सह (दुस्सह) a. unbearable, irresistible, insupportable.
 भवत्यनिष्टादपि नाम दुःसहात् Ku.
दुस् + -साक्षिन् m. a false witness.

दुस् + -साध, -साध्य a.
—1 difficult to be accomplished or managed.
—2 difficult to be cured.
—3 difficult to be conquered.

दुस् + -साध, -साध्य a.
—1 difficult to be accomplished or managed.
—2 difficult to be cured.
—3 difficult to be conquered.
दुस् + -साधिन् m. door-keeper; L. D. B.
दुस् + -सुप्त a. having bad dreams (in oneʼs sleep).

दुस् + -स्थ, -स्थित a. (written also दुस्थ and दुस्थित)
—1 ill-conditioned, poor, miserable.
—2 suffering pain, unhappy, distressed; कल्पान्तदुःस्था वसुधा तथोहे Bk.
—3 unwell, ill.
—4 unsteady, disquieted.
—5 foolish, unwise, ignorant.

दुस् + -स्थ, -स्थित a. (written also दुस्थ and दुस्थित)
—1 ill-conditioned, poor, miserable.
—2 suffering pain, unhappy, distressed; कल्पान्तदुःस्था वसुधा तथोहे Bk.
—3 unwell, ill.
—4 unsteady, disquieted.
—5 foolish, unwise, ignorant.

दुस् + -स्थम् ind. badly, ill, unwell; दुःस्थं तिष्ठसि यच्च पथ्यमधुना
 कर्तास्मि तच्छ्रोष्यसि; Amaru.

दुस् + -स्थितिः f.
—1 bad condition or situation, unhappiness, misery.
—2 instability.

दुस् + -स्पृष्टम् (दुः, दुस्पृष्टम्)
—1 slight touch or contact.
—2 slight touch or action of the tongue which produces the sounds य्,
 र्, ल् and व्; दुस्पृष्टश्चेति विज्ञेयो ऌकारः प्लुत एव च.
दुस् + -स्फाटः a kind of weapon; L. D. B.
दुस् + -स्मर a. hard or painful to remember; U. 6. 34.
दुस् + -स्वप्नः a bad dream.
